        // vpkstuff patch: the ceiling vrf-kv3-size-guard holds a block's declared uncompressed
        // size to. A host parsing untrusted files lowers it per async flow.
        /// <summary>512 MB: the largest real block measured is 303,244,222 bytes (de_boulder's world_physics PHYS).</summary>
        public const long DefaultMaxUncompressedBytes = 512L << 20;

        private static readonly System.Threading.AsyncLocal<long?> maxUncompressedBytes = new();

        /// <summary>The ceiling in force: the innermost <see cref="UseMaxUncompressedBytes"/>, else the default.</summary>
        public static long MaxUncompressedBytes => maxUncompressedBytes.Value ?? DefaultMaxUncompressedBytes;

        /// <summary>Lower the ceiling for this async flow until the result is disposed; never raises it.</summary>
        public static IDisposable UseMaxUncompressedBytes(long bytes)
        {
            ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegative(bytes);
            var outer = maxUncompressedBytes.Value;
            maxUncompressedBytes.Value = Math.Min(bytes, outer ?? DefaultMaxUncompressedBytes);
            return new LimitScope(outer);
        }

        private sealed class LimitScope(long? outer) : IDisposable
        {
            private bool disposed;

            public void Dispose()
            {
                if (disposed)
                {
                    return;
                }

                disposed = true;
                maxUncompressedBytes.Value = outer;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="BinaryKV3"/> class with DATA block type.
